name: HAWC
summary: High-altitude wide-field water-Cherenkov gamma-ray observatory continuously monitoring the sky and searching the Galactic halo and dwarf galaxies for dark-matter signals.
detection_principle: Ground water tanks record Cherenkov light from air-shower secondaries; arrival times and charge reconstruct source direction and energy.

results.summary: Optimized Galactic-halo dark-matter search yielding model-dependent constraints.

science_scope: Tests dark-matter models through astrophysical radiation, cosmic rays or neutrinos. Astrophysical backgrounds and propagation models affect interpretation; an anomaly alone does not establish dark matter.
